purpose: Teach: 用件/彼岸/食中毒/雑用/口元/鳴く/透け/車窓

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前に、本気で、絶対、用件、絶対、あって、絶対、電話したよ
lines.en: Riku — I actually called you because I need something serious.
lines.style: Direct, urgent opening. No hesitation. Bright surface but underneath it: she's nervous and trying not to show it. Quick clip on the name.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、彼岸、絶対、お墓参り、絶対、行くんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. My grandmother's actually going to visit the family grave during the equinox, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning. Not defensive — just laying fact down. Pause before the name, like he's checking she's still listening. Steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お弁当、本気で、絶対、食中毒、絶対、気をつけてね、リク
lines.en: Be careful with the lunch I made you, okay? Food poisoning's no joke, Riku.
lines.style: Gentle instruction, almost offhand. The care underneath is genuine but she won't make a show of it. Soft on his name — concern wrapped in practicality.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、本気で、絶対、部活の、絶対、雑用、絶対、俺が、絶対、引き受けたぜ、桜
lines.en: I actually volunteered to take on all the club prep work today, Sakura.
lines.style: Small pride underneath. Not bragging — just telling her something he wants her to know. Slight lift on the claim. Her name like he's sharing something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、口元、絶対、笑ってると、絶対、優しく、絶対、見えるよ、リク
lines.en: When you smile like that — around your mouth — you actually look kind, you know? Riku.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost tender. Like she's noticed something true and is risking saying it. Slower pace. Slight breathiness on the compliment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 校庭の鳥、本気で、絶対、鳴く、絶対、声、絶対、朝、絶対、聞こえるよな、桜
lines.en: You hear the birds singing on the school grounds in the morning, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Reflective, almost dreamy. Like he's noticing something small and true. Gentle pace. Trailing off slightly — inviting her into the moment rather than pushing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のシャツ、本気で、絶対、薄くて、絶対、透けて、絶対、見えるよ、リク
lines.en: Your shirt's so thin it's see-through, by the way, Riku.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact observation with a wry smile underneath. Not unkind — she's pointing something out he should know. Quick, almost teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行の、本気で、絶対、車窓、絶対、景色、絶対、お前と、絶対、見たいよな、桜
lines.en: I want to see the scenery from the school trip bus with you, Sakura.
lines.style: Vulnerable opening. This is a real ask, not casual. Slight catch in the breath on 'want.' Her name gentle at the end — he needs her to hear him.
